scams.name: The Centraal Station Taxi Gang
scams.avoidance: Use the official taxi rank (TCA taxis) or pre-book through the Uber app Bolt and Uber both operate in Amsterdam at metered rates Official taxis are metered by law and must provide receipts — insist on both

scams.name: The Fake / Stepped-On Weed Dealer
scams.avoidance: Buy exclusively from licensed coffeeshops — they're everywhere and perfectly legal Street dealers have zero accountability and zero quality control
scams.location: Leidseplein, Red Light District, near coffeeshops

scams.name: The Red Light District Tourist Trap Restaurant
scams.avoidance: Walk 2-3 blocks off the main tourist corridors for dramatically better value Apps like Google Maps filtered for 4+ stars from >200 reviews work well Avoid anywhere a host is actively recruiting customers
scams.location: Red Light District (De Wallen), Damrak strip

scams.name: The Bicycle Rental Damage Deposit Trap
scams.avoidance: Take dated photos of every scratch before leaving the shop Use the city's official OV-fiets bike share scheme instead Rent from established shops with hundreds of Google reviews
scams.location: Bicycle rental shops near Centraal, tourist areas

scams.name: The Fake Hash / Drug Offer Near Coffeeshop
scams.avoidance: Ignore all street drug approaches entirely Coffeeshops are legal and regulated — use them exclusively for cannabis
